entries.scope: Sandbox README and learner navigation to the canonical Level-0 practice guide
entries.rationale: Sandbox readers need a short route to the new guide and a clear reminder of local mount and credential boundaries.
readerPaths: Sandbox README -> online Level-0 practice guide -> sandbox isolation record
Learner documentation -> practice guide -> local script and mount rules
entries.navigationImpact: Short links in the existing documentation-path table and learner index; no local copy of the practice guide.
entries.languageStrategy: German first, equivalent English second; descriptive text links and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Local links and repository documentation checks; the embedded Level-0 source remains pinned and may lag the online guide. No image build, practical screen-reader test, or Braille test is claimed.
entries.risk: The cross-repository link depends on the published Level-0 guide remaining accessible; the local pinned source may remain older.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Level-0 guide location or publication, sandbox mount policy, credential boundary, or embedded source pin changes.

entries.scope: Re-render the Git-derived Statistics Profile 2 after committing the sandbox documentation links
entries.rationale: The committed text changes the statistics snapshot and the Homogeneity Check requires the generated block to match the committed source revision.
entries.navigationImpact: The existing statistics location and links stay in place.
entries.languageStrategy: Existing bilingual Profile 2 labels and text alternatives remain generated by the renderer.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The existing renderer is previewed, run, and checked against the committed Git history; the affected Homogeneity Check is rerun on the exact PR head.
entries.risk: An unrendered snapshot makes the cross-platform Homogeneity Check fail; hand edits would break reproducibility.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Changes to tracked text, statistics configuration, renderer logic, or source history.
